Hey everyone,

message.subject: Customer feedback summary
message.preview: Top 5 UX issues from the latest NPS survey.
message.body:
Team,
Compiled the top UX issues from last week's NPS survey (n=1,200):
1. Search results load time (reported by 34% of detractors) 2. Mobile navigation confusing after redesign (28%) 3. Dark mode contrast issues on data tables (19%) 4. Export to CSV missing column headers (14%) 5. Notification settings too granular (11%)
We should prioritize #1 and #2 for Q3. I've created tickets in Linear — please take a look.
Irene

message.subject: Re: Q3 roadmap review
message.preview: Here are my thoughts on the design system timeline.
message.body:
Alice,
Thanks for putting this together. A few thoughts:
— The design system timeline feels aggressive. I'd suggest pushing token finalization to sprint 4 to give Bob's team enough breathing room. — API migration priority order looks right but we should add a hard dependency check for the /upload and /auth endpoints. — Happy to present the engineering section at the board meeting.
Let's discuss Wednesday.
Best, Me

message.subject: Re: Design system updates
message.preview: Reviewed the new tokens — looks great, one comment on border radii.
message.body:
Bob,
The new token set looks great overall. One thing:
— Border radius tokens: the jump from 4pt to 12pt is a bit wide. Can we add an 8pt intermediate? We have several cards and modals that would benefit from a subtler curve than 12pt.
Everything else looks good. Great work on the semantic shadows.
Me

message.subject: Re: Customer feedback summary
message.preview: Good analysis — let's tackle search performance first.

Irene,
This is a great summary. I agree #1 (search performance) and #2 (mobile nav) should be top priority.
For search: let's timebox an investigation next sprint. I suspect the index is stale — simple reindexing could fix most of the reported slowness.
I'll pick up the search investigation ticket. Thanks for pulling this together.
Me

CFP proposal for SwiftCraft 2026:
Talk title: "Building Native macOS Apps with Lua — The lua-objc Story"
Abstract: lua-objc combines the speed and simplicity of Lua with native AppKit controls to deliver production-quality macOS applications. This talk covers the architecture, lessons learned, and practical examples of building real apps with the framework.

message.subject: CI/CD pipeline upgrade complete
message.preview: All pipelines migrated to the new infrastructure.
message.body:
The CI/CD pipeline upgrade is complete. Here's what changed:
— Build agents upgraded from m6i.large to m6i.xlarge — Build times reduced by ~35% on average — New caching layer for dependencies (no more clean npm installs) — Parallel test execution enabled (2x faster test suite runs)
All 12 pipelines have been migrated. Please report any issues in #devops-help.
— DevOps
